Name: DEFAULT_KEY_ASSIGN
Description: Default low-level input map: physical pad, keyboard and mouse inputs for the debug tools and in-game input actions. Loaded from the system param file, not the regulation. Appears unused by the game: it is loaded, but the game's default bindings are built into the executable. Player rebinding uses KeyAssignParam_TypeA/B/C. Retail row groups: 0-40 Debug Menu, 1000 Pause, 2000 Debug Camera, 3000 In-Game, 4000 Boot Menu, 5000 Map Decal, 6000 Menu Viewer, 7000 Model Viewer.

Fields.Name: Input 0 Physical Key
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: the physical input for this action; -1 = slot empty. Slots 0-3 hold pad inputs, 4-7 keyboard and mouse. Pad: 3/4 left stick X/Y, 5/6 right stick X/Y, 7/8 L2/R2, 51-54 D-pad up/down/left/right, 55 Start, 56 Select/touchpad press, 57/58 L3/R3, 59/60 L1/R1, 61 Cross, 62 Circle, 63 Square, 64 Triangle, 65 confirm button, 66 cancel button, 97-109 PS4 motion gestures, 118/119 touchpad right/left. Mouse: 0/1 X/Y movement, 2 wheel, 35-37 left/right/middle button. Keys: 1000 Ctrl, 1001 Alt, 1002 Shift, 248/250/251/253 arrow up/left/right/down.
